label: Auth Guard + Apple Wallet
changes: Fixed: all /api/* routes now require Gmail authentication via before_request guard
Added /auth/status endpoint so the UI can check auth state without receiving a 401
Implemented Apple Wallet .pkpass generation (wallet.py) for tickets, boarding passes, and receipts
Added /api/email/<id>/wallet endpoint — downloads a .pkpass file for any ticket email
Wired 'Add to Wallet' button in the UI to the new wallet endpoint
Removed passkit4py dependency (replaced with stdlib zipfile + hashlib approach)
